overview: This single-page file consists of a Department of State list-of-papers sheet concerning investment of Taiwanese (Formosan) capital in British Malaya. It records a Hong Kong communication dated October 19 and notes that the Bank of Formosa proposed special loans for Japanese merchants, farmers, and industrialists operating in Malaya and the Netherlands Indies, while directing researchers to related file 894.51/474.

subfiles.summary: The list-of-papers sheet identifies the subject as investment of Formosan capital in the Federated Malay States and records a Hong Kong item dated October 19. Its note states that the Bank of Formosa would make special loans to Japanese merchants, farmers, and industrialists in Malaya and the Netherlands Indies. It refers readers to file 894.51/474 for the substantive documentation.

interest: Although only an index sheet survives here, it documents the archival relationship between Japanese overseas economic activity and financing from colonial Taiwan. The reference to targeted credit for merchants, farmers, and industrialists suggests a coordinated effort to extend Japanese commercial influence across Southeast Asia. The cross-reference to file 894.51/474 is especially useful for locating the underlying report and reconstructing the broader documentary trail.
